_comment: From the v1 AndroidManifest (four intent-filters) and
MainActivity.handleDeepLink. The scheme is HARDCODED to `stationly` in
both, on every host — which is the bug iOS shipped and then had to fix:
a hardcoded scheme silently dropped every staging tap, with nothing
erroring and taps simply doing nothing. AV2-3.4 makes the scheme
per-flavour; this table records the routing that must survive that change.

routes.note: Opens the app. A no-op beyond that in v1.
Named `auth`, means 'the reset finished'. Kept as-is: the name is on published links we do not control.
No oobCode. v1 checks isNullOrBlank and does nothing — it does NOT navigate to a broken verify screen.
Blank oobCode is the same as absent.
Wrong scheme. v1 has no http intent-filter at all, so this never reaches the app.
Under the v1 scheme. This is exactly the tap that vanished on iOS.
